taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Free aggregate discovery is the default broad-universe path.
Every first-seen candidate records source, source timestamp, system timestamp, source rank, and all subsequent discovery sources.
The system maintains a point-in-time discovery-universe registry sufficient to measure source overlap, unique yield, and `NOT_DISCOVERED` misses.
Cheap monitoring is batch-oriented and finite; it does not create one scheduler message/workflow per candidate.
Candidate promotion from cheap monitoring to free-quota verification is deterministic and versioned.
